financials.source: Becker's Hospital Review citing audited financials; total assets from system investment office disclosure (FY2025 figure)

balanceSheetWealth.investmentPortfolioSource: Audited consolidated financial statements (FY ending June 30, 2024) report $7.537B in total long-term investments ($6.927B unrestricted, $610M restricted). Confirmed as prior-year comparatives in FY2025 audit filed on EMMA (MSRB). Unrestricted portfolio includes ~$83M under measurement alternative. Asset classes include public equity, diversifiers, private equity/debt, and private real assets managed via external managers.
balanceSheetWealth.realEstateSource: Direct real estate holdings confirmed but value not publicly broken out
balanceSheetWealth.notes: System reported $17.5B in total assets as of fiscal 2025. Net income of $2B in fiscal 2024 included significant investment returns above the $1.2B operating income.

communityBenefit.source: BSW Health community investment page; includes $450M charity care and unreimbursed Medicaid, $750M unreimbursed Medicare, $27M subsidized health services; claimed ~$1B annually (~$2.7M per day)

taxAdvantage.notes: Texas has no state income tax. BSW is exempt from federal income tax, property tax, and sales tax. Tax-exempt bond interest subsidy applies to $5.5B+ in outstanding debt. Full estimated annual tax advantage not computed due to missing property and sales tax data.

layoffs.description: Corporate services restructuring; part of plan to outsource, lay off, or retrain 1,700 positions expected to save $600M over five years. Over 100 jobs cut in Austin-Round Rock area and 70+ in Dallas area.
layoffs.source: Becker's Hospital Review; KXAN; Healthcare Finance News

layoffs.description: Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation - Home Health in Flower Mound permanently closed, laying off approximately 80 employees including nurses.
layoffs.source: Dallas Morning News; Becker's Hospital Review; WARN Tracker

ratios.investmentsToOperatingIncomeInterpretati: BSW holds $7.537B in long-term investments against $1.2B in operating income (FY2024), a 6.28x ratio — meaning for every dollar of operating income the system generates, it holds $6.28 in investment assets. This is among the highest ratios in the nonprofit health system sector.
ratios.bondDebtToCommunityBenefitInterpretation: BSW carries $5.5B in tax-exempt bond debt, 5.5x its claimed $1B annual community benefit, meaning for every dollar of community benefit claimed, the system holds $5.50 in subsidized debt
ratios.charityCareVsStateInterpretation: Texas state average not verified; BSW claims $450M in charity care against ~$15.2B in revenue (~3.0%), but cost-adjusted figures not available to compare against state benchmarks

accusation: Baylor Scott & White Health commands $17.5 billion in total assets and posted $2 billion in net income in fiscal 2024 while laying off more than 800 employees across three rounds of cuts, closing a rehabilitation facility, and co-investing over $200 million in a sports medicine complex at the Dallas Cowboys' Star headquarters in Frisco.
